# Dayblip

> Free calculators and tools for personal finance, career decisions, life visualization, date math and birth-year facts. No signup, no email and no paywall.

## What is on the site
- Date tools: age calculator, date calculator, days between dates, countdowns
- Finance and money calculators
- Life and money insights
- Health and lifestyle, real estate, and productivity tools
- Born-in pages for 1940 to 2020 and On This Day pages
- Games, quizzes and live world counters
- 200+ free tools in total
- Blog articles that explain the numbers behind the tools

## Notes
Some links are affiliate links, and Dayblip may earn a commission on sign-ups or purchases. See https://www.dayblip.com/disclosure
